newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi signs $117 mln water distribution contract.
newsitem.headline: Saudi signs $117 mln water distribution contract.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has signed a 441 million riyal ($117.6 million) contract to build a pumping station and two pipelines to distribute desalinated water in the kingdom's eastern province, newspapers reported on Monday.

They said Agriculture and Water Minister Abdullah bin Abdul-Aziz bin Muammar signed the contract on Sunday with a Turkish company. They did not name the company and Turkish embassy officials were not available for comment.
The newspapers said the project, which includes the construction of two pipelines carrying a total of 408,991 cubic metres of water a day, will be completed in two years.
